senses: (bound form) standard weight used with a balance scale
(coll.) kilometers per hour (informal misuse of "yard" to mean kph in speed references)
classifier for matters, items, situations etc (esp. when indicating whether they are the same or different, as in 不是一码事 "not the same thing")
(Tw, HK) (finance) unit of 25 basis points (i.e. a 0.25% change in interest rate)
